text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commission in charge of social dialogue to resume talks on October 8.
- King Hassan's Economic Adviser Andre Azoulay meets French businessmen to convince them of Morocco's will to set up effective partnership with Europe.
- Parliamentary commission on drugs to present report on Friday.
- Finance Minister Kabbaj forecasts five percent growth in gross domestic product for 1997.
- Police arrest four Spaniards on drug charges near northern town of Tetuan.
- Census of travel agencies reveals irregularities in granting licences.
- Medi 1, Moroccan French radio station based in Tangier, successful since launch in 1980.
- No hint on fate of loss-making private channel 2M.
- Moroccan state-owned airline Royal Air Maroc made net profit of 74 million dirhams ($8.5 million) in first eight months of 1996.
